ruler_sizing.reason: Upstream FWE at 16K and QA SQuAD at 64K can exceed the context including generation and BOS/prefix.
ruler_sizing.resolution: Regenerate the entire deterministic task with generator_window reduced by maximum measured overflow plus eight tokens, repeating until all first 100 examples fit. Preserve every sample ID and actual generator_window. Never truncate or omit an input.

code_grader.reason: Current filelock refuses fork from concurrent code_eval workers; spawn without preloaded numpy makes canonical plus tests fail to import numpy after the reliability guard.
code_grader.resolution: Python forkserver with numpy preloaded; retain unmodified code_eval reliability guard and full plus tests with timeout 20 seconds.
code_grader.controls: Canonical plus solution passes and deliberately invalid program fails.

ruler_generation_replay.finding: Upstream samplers use global Python random state in addition to local seed42 shuffles. A regenerated set can differ across invocations.
ruler_generation_replay.resolution: All measurements and future stage comparisons must replay the complete frozen token IDs and raw documents under inputs-sha256.json. Do not regenerate a comparator dataset. Frozen prompt SHA256s are the benchmark identity.
